lines: Good afternoon. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.
Toronto police identify suspect in violent Bridle Path home invasion, say he was also shot, The Canadian Press reports.
Residents evacuated from Russian-occupied Oleshky reach Ukraine after localized ceasefire, The Associated Press reports.

More than 160,000 people across Germany are expected to join demonstrations on Saturday, organizers say, as a youth-led movement inspired by protests elsewhere in Europe takes to the streets to demand better education and lower living costs, The Canadian Press reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
